probe: Create equal-shaped [256,2] GGML tensors for all 36 live types and all nine public ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV and ADD_CAST constructors allowed by their source guards. Query both devices before allocation and inspect each admitted node after a sole-provider scheduler split. Execute the 48 scalar and E4M3 graphs on both backends with finite nonzero divisors, restore the inputs before in-place runs and poison copied outputs. Reuse VT-169 for the direct packed results and VT-176 for composed codebook results and VT-179 for half and bfloat inputs with packed outputs. VT-180 compares the newly placed packed binary forms to original GGML row decoding, F32 graphs and row encoding. Unclassified denotes no identified direct or composed oracle in this survey.
